import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (low high : Int) (left right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def low (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ l _ _ _ => l

def high (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ h _ _ => h

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ l _ => l

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Int → Option Int :=
  fun k =>
    if k < t.low ∨ k ≥ t.high then none
    else
      match t.left, t.right with
      | some l, some r =>
          if k < l.high then view l k else view r k
      | _, _ => some t.val
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_segment_tree (t : Node) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ t.low ∧ t.low < t.high ∧ 0 ≤ t.val ∧
  match t.left, t.right with
  | some l, some r =>
      let mid := (t.low + t.high) / 2
      l.low = t.low ∧ l.high = mid ∧
      r.low = mid ∧ r.high = t.high ∧
      is_segment_tree l ∧ is_segment_tree r ∧
      t.val = max l.val r.val
  | none, none =>
      t.high = t.low + 1
  | _, _ => False
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def query_precond (node : Node) (ql qr : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_segment_tree node ∧
  ql < qr ∧
  node.low ≤ ql ∧
  qr ≤ node.high
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def tva (t : Node) (k : Int) : Int :=
  match view t k with
  | some v => v
  | none => 0

def intMaxRange (f : Int → Int) (l : Int) (n : Nat) : Int :=
  match n with
  | 0 => f l
  | (m + 1) => max (f l) (intMaxRange f (l + 1) m)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def query (node : Node) (ql qr : Int)
    (h_precond : query_precond node ql qr) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  intMaxRange (tva node) ql (qr - ql - 1).toNat
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Abstract View Helper used in Postcond
def tree_view_at (t : Node) (k : Int) : Int :=
  match view t k with
  | some v => v
  | none => 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def query_postcond (node : Node) (ql qr : Int) (result : Int)
    (_ : query_precond node ql qr) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ k, ql ≤ k ∧ k < qr → tree_view_at node k ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ k, ql ≤ k ∧ k < qr ∧ tree_view_at node k = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma tva_eq (t : Node) (k : Int) : tree_view_at t k = tva t k := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp [tree_view_at, tva])
  | (unfold tree_view_at tva)

lemma view_leaf (v lo hi : Int) (k : Int) :
    view (Node.mk v lo hi none none) k = (if k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi then none else some v) := by
  first
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view]; simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view]; simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (simp only [view]; simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)

lemma view_branch (v lo hi : Int) (l r : Node) (k : Int) :
    view (Node.mk v lo hi (some l) (some r)) k =
      (if k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi then none else if k < l.high then view l k else view r k) := by
  first
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view]; simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)
  | (rw [view]; simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right]; done)

lemma tva_leaf (v lo hi : Int) (k : Int) :
    tva (Node.mk v lo hi none none) k = (if k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi then 0 else v) := by
  by_cases hc : k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi
  · first
    | (simp [tva, view_leaf, hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_leaf, if_pos hc, if_pos hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_leaf]; simp [hc]; done)
  · first
    | (simp [tva, view_leaf, hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_leaf, if_neg hc, if_neg hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_leaf]; simp [hc]; done)

lemma tva_branch (v lo hi : Int) (l r : Node) (k : Int) :
    tva (Node.mk v lo hi (some l) (some r)) k =
      (if k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi then 0 else if k < l.high then tva l k else tva r k) := by
  by_cases hc : k < lo ∨ k ≥ hi
  · first
    | (simp [tva, view_branch, hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch, if_pos hc, if_pos hc]; done)
    | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch]; simp [hc]; done)
  · by_cases hc2 : k < l.high
    · first
      | (simp [tva, view_branch, hc, hc2]; done)
      | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch, if_neg hc, if_neg hc, if_pos hc2, if_pos hc2]; done)
      | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch]; simp [hc, hc2]; done)
    · first
      | (simp [tva, view_branch, hc, hc2]; done)
      | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch, if_neg hc, if_neg hc, if_neg hc2, if_neg hc2]; done)
      | (unfold tva; rw [view_branch]; simp [hc, hc2]; done)

lemma ist_basic (t : Node) (h : is_segment_tree t) :
    0 ≤ t.low ∧ t.low < t.high ∧ 0 ≤ t.val := by
  first
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩)
  | (simp only [is_segment_tree] at h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩)

lemma ist_leaf (v lo hi : Int) (h : is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi none none)) :
    0 ≤ lo ∧ lo < hi ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧ hi = lo + 1 := by
  first
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; tauto)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; tauto)

lemma ist_branch (v lo hi : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi (some l) (some r))) :
    0 ≤ lo ∧ lo < hi ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧
      l.low = lo ∧ l.high = (lo + hi) / 2 ∧ r.low = (lo + hi) / 2 ∧ r.high = hi ∧
      is_segment_tree l ∧ is_segment_tree r ∧ v = max l.val r.val := by
  first
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; tauto)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; tauto)

lemma ist_absurd1 (v lo hi : Int) (l : Node) :
    ¬ is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi (some l) none) := by
  intro h
  first
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h.2.2.2)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h.2.2.2)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h; simp at h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h; simp at h)

lemma ist_absurd2 (v lo hi : Int) (r : Node) :
    ¬ is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi none (some r)) := by
  intro h
  first
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h.2.2.2)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h;
     simp only [Node.low, Node.high, Node.val, Node.left, Node.right] at h; exact h.2.2.2)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def] at h; simp at h)
  | (rw [is_segment_tree] at h; simp at h)

lemma tva_nonneg_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (t : Node), (t.high - t.low).toNat ≤ n →
    is_segment_tree t → ∀ k, 0 ≤ tva t k := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t hn hst k
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := ist_basic t hst
    omega
  | succ m ih =>
    intro t hn hst k
    obtain ⟨v, lo, hi, left, right⟩ := t
    simp only [Node.low, Node.high] at hn
    rcases left with _ | l
    · rcases right with _ | r
      · rw [tva_leaf]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ist_leaf v lo hi hst
        split
        · omega
        · omega
      · exact absurd hst (ist_absurd2 v lo hi r)
    · rcases right with _ | r
      · exact absurd hst (ist_absurd1 v lo hi l)
      · rw [tva_branch]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10⟩ := ist_branch v lo hi l r hst
        obtain ⟨_, hl2, _⟩ := ist_basic l h8
        obtain ⟨_, hr2, _⟩ := ist_basic r h9
        split
        · omega
        · split
          · exact ih l (by omega) h8 k
          · exact ih r (by omega) h9 k

lemma tva_nonneg (t : Node) (h : is_segment_tree t) (k : Int) : 0 ≤ tva t k :=
  tva_nonneg_aux (t.high - t.low).toNat t (le_refl _) h k

lemma intMaxRange_step (f : Int → Int) (l : Int) (m : Nat) :
    intMaxRange f l (m + 1) = max (f l) (intMaxRange f (l + 1) m) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [intMaxRange])
  | (simp [intMaxRange])

lemma intMaxRange_zero (f : Int → Int) (l : Int) : intMaxRange f l 0 = f l := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [intMaxRange])
  | (simp [intMaxRange])

lemma intMaxRange_ge : ∀ (n : Nat) (f : Int → Int) (l k : Int),
    l ≤ k → k ≤ l + (n : Int) → f k ≤ intMaxRange f l n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f l k h1 h2
    have hk : k = l := by omega
    subst hk
    rw [intMaxRange_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f l k h1 h2
    rw [intMaxRange_step]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
    · subst h
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_trans (ih f (l + 1) k (by omega) (by omega)) (le_max_right _ _)

lemma intMaxRange_attained : ∀ (n : Nat) (f : Int → Int) (l : Int),
    ∃ k, l ≤ k ∧ k ≤ l + (n : Int) ∧ f k = intMaxRange f l n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f l
    refine ⟨l, le_refl l, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [intMaxRange_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f l
    rcases le_total (f l) (intMaxRange f (l + 1) m) with h | h
    · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := ih f (l + 1)
      refine ⟨k, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [intMaxRange_step, max_eq_right h]
      exact hk3
    · refine ⟨l, le_refl l, by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [intMaxRange_step, max_eq_left h]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem query_postcond_satisfied (node : Node) (ql qr : Int)
    (h_precond : query_precond node ql qr) :
    query_postcond node ql qr (query node ql qr h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hstree : is_segment_tree node := h_precond.1
  have hlt : ql < qr := h_precond.2.1
  have hq : query node ql qr h_precond
      = intMaxRange (tva node) ql (qr - ql - 1).toNat := by
    first
    | rfl
    | (simp only [query])
    | (unfold query)
  obtain ⟨k0, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := intMaxRange_attained (qr - ql - 1).toNat (tva node) ql
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hq, ← hk3]
    have h := tva_nonneg node hstree k0
    omega
  · intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hka, hkb⟩ := hk
    rw [hq, tva_eq]
    exact intMaxRange_ge (qr - ql - 1).toNat (tva node) ql k hka (by omega)
  · refine ⟨k0, hk1, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [hq, tva_eq]
    exact hk3
  -- !benchmark @end proof

def high (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ h _ _ => h

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ l _ => l

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Int → Option Int :=
  fun k =>
    if k < t.low ∨ k ≥ t.high then none
    else
      match t.left, t.right with
      | some l, some r =>
          if k < l.high then view l k else view r k
      | _, _ => some t.val
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_segment_tree (t : Node) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ t.low ∧ t.low < t.high ∧ 0 ≤ t.val ∧
  match t.left, t.right with
  | some l, some r =>
      let mid := (t.low + t.high) / 2
      l.low = t.low ∧ l.high = mid ∧
      r.low = mid ∧ r.high = t.high ∧
      is_segment_tree l ∧ is_segment_tree r ∧
      t.val = max l.val r.val
  | none, none =>
      t.high = t.low + 1
  | _, _ => False
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

@[reducible, simp]
def query_precond (node : Node) (ql qr : Int) : Prop :=

  is_segment_tree node ∧

  node.low ≤ ql ∧
  qr ≤ node.high

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def tva (t : Node) (k : Int) : Int :=
  match view t k with
  | some v => v
  | none => 0

def intMaxRange (f : Int → Int) (l : Int) (n : Nat) : Int :=
  match n with
  | 0 => f l
  | (m + 1) => max (f l) (intMaxRange f (l + 1) m)

lemma tva_nonneg_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (t : Node), (t.high - t.low).toNat ≤ n →
    is_segment_tree t → ∀ k, 0 ≤ tva t k := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t hn hst k
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := ist_basic t hst
    omega

        · omega
        · split
          · exact ih l (by omega) h8 k
          · exact ih r (by omega) h9 k

lemma tva_nonneg (t : Node) (h : is_segment_tree t) (k : Int) : 0 ≤ tva t k :=
